item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, it will become fine and very hot over southern China in the next couple of days. The northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong on Wednesday. It will be windy with a few showers and temperatures will fall slightly over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early next week.
